monitored_text: Service Overview Compression Molding Services Compression molding creates rubber parts by forcing a heated block of rubber into a metal cavity of the part shape. eMachineShop offers cost-effective rubber compression molding solutions whether you need a hundred pieces or a large production order. 50+ Materials. FREE Shipping in the USA. 100% Quality Guaranteed. As Seen In: Advantages Economical for large quantities Metallic inserts can be added Draft not required No ejection marks Applications O-rings Seals Gaskets Pulleys What is Rubber Compression Molding? Rubber compression molding is a process by which a block of rubber is heated and pressed into a metal cavity. As the mold closes, the rubber is compressed and then flows directly into the cavity where it hardens to the desired part shape. Many rubbers can be compression molded, including NBR nitrile, neoprene, silicone, and santoprene.
